description: IMSS medical-benefits regulation admitted as a test of a regulation that adopts LSS Article 5 A.
notes: Operator authorized the admission on 2026-10-18 as a test case for ingestion into a more populated and linked corpus.
The Cámara de Diputados current-regulations index (norma/reglamento.htm) lists this instrument with its DOF publication of 2006-11-30 and no reforms; regla/n29.pdf is that publication.
Article 2 adopts the definitions of LSS Article 5 A, as reg-lss-macerf and reg-lss-maeba do.

instruments.title: REGLAMENTO de Prestaciones Médicas del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social
